title: Hassan-e-Masmoom Day Janazay Tay Behna Ay Vain Paundian
body:
Nana Zahra Jaiyan Kadi Bhulsi Na Wafawan
Tere Kalmagoan Diyan
<<DIVIDER>>
Pani Dittan Zeher Pilaya Dhokay Nal Joda Nay X2
Rondeya Tere Behan Tay Suniya Naal Na Haavan
Qasim Di Ujri Maa Diyan
<<DIVIDER>>
Pyasa Tur Chalaya Ay Veeran Aj Tu Is Duniya Ton X2
Behna Kol Ja Hondiyan Milda Zeher Na Tenu
Asi Paanian Nu Pilaundian
<<DIVIDER>>
Chaya Jad Veeran Nay Aakay Pak Hassan Da Janaza X2
Ujrian Behna Ton Lathgaiyan [Asiyan] Lokon
Hai Chadaran Paa [Pisla Diyan]
<<DIVIDER>>
Lakht-e-Jigar Di Maut Da Sunkay Dukhia Dil Zahra Da X2
Dukhiya Maa Nay Ron’diyan Aawazan Si Lokon
Bakiye Cho Mur Mur Aundiyan
<<DIVIDER>>
Jeevain Hassan Da Pak Janaza Mur Kay Ghar Nu Aaya X2
Baaj Dafnawan Day Teeran Nal Inna Zakhmi
Nayi Mayyatan Ghar Nu Jandiyan
<<DIVIDER>>
Karday Sabz Qabah Aqdas Tay Nazran Karam Diyan X2
Mangday Jo Momin Sab Kar Manzoor Duawan
Meray Mola [Auladiyan]
